## Intended untimed flow — fail-closed checks (source lines)

- **Target/IP/systemd policy (driver L164–171):** nonce regex first, then hostname `kaltura-php74-baseline`, then `ip -j -4 addr` must contain `192.168.56.74` and exclude `.20/.21/.30/.83`, then unit name `baseline-untimed-[0-9a-f]{8}` + `systemctl show` requiring `NoNewPrivileges=yes`, `0.0.0.0/0`, `::/0`, `192.168.56.74`, `127.`. Ordering is fail-closed (tests: wrong-nonce-before-host, wrong-host-before-commands, wrong-ip-before-auth). Runner enforces the same at launch (run_untimed.py L60: `IPAddressDeny=any`, Allow localhost + `192.168.56.74/32`, `NoNewPrivileges`, `ProtectSystem=strict`, `ProtectHome=read-only`, `PrivateTmp`, `RuntimeMaxSec=1100`).
- **Source identity:** driver L172–173 `read_file` + SHA == `612d179c…63b5473`; runner L47–48 refuses frozen-media drift before staging, L50–59 pins `{rel: sha}` manifest + `runner_sha256` + `source_sha256` into `untimed-stage-manifest.json`. Fixture is fixed synthetic `short360.mp4`; no live credentials in repo (only format regexes + `synthetic-*` markers in tests).
- **Guest-private secret + API POST privacy:** `sql()` L38–48 allows only `SELECT ` without `;`, reads `/root/kaltura-baseline-private/mysql-password` via private `read_file` (0600/0700), 48-hex format check, memfd 0600 + `pass_fds` (never argv). Credentials file L207–211 `O_EXCL` 0600 under `0700` nonce dir, guest-side only. Transport is POST-body-only queryless (`transport.py` L38–51); upload worker posts `ks` in multipart body (driver L143–151); `_probe_worker`/`_upload_worker` map all exceptions to `state=-2`, never marshaling bodies/exceptions. `api_value` L24–28 strips API messages to `API_<CODE>`/`API_REJECTED`.
- **Logger config / canary / auth log gating:** `logging_preflight` L86–113 requires `logger.ini`, `Zend_Log_Writer_Stream` only, sinks under `/opt/kaltura/log/` or php stdio, rejects `@@/omfwd/omrelp/omhttp/omprog`, `@` remote, apache pipe/body modules, nginx `syslog:`/`$request_body`, plus running-agent deny list. `privacy()` L63–85 requires patterns ≥16B, 64MiB caps, symlink/size fails, `JOURNAL_SINCE` set at L163 and required at L77, `journalctl --since` under `RLIMIT_FSIZE`. Invalid-canary (`invalid-<nonce>-secret-marker`) must yield hits `[0]` (L192–197); valid secret+ks must yield `[0,0]` pre and post (L205, L263). Tests cover short-pattern, missing-logger, forwarder detection.
- **Owned synthetic partner/media upload:** partner from `/root/kaltura-sanity.rc` `PARTNER_ID`, DB provenance `sanity@kaltura.local` (L183–186), `user-<nonce>` type-0 session; wrong-secret and type-2 escalation must both reject with `API_START_SESSION_ERROR` (L193–204). Upload token regex, nonce-bound multipart boundary + param-name injection guard (L134–141, tests cover collision/injection/exact-bytes). Entry nonce-scoped name/tags/referenceId, `mediaType:1`; ready-poll ≤600s rejecting `-1/-2/3` (L222–228).
- **Original file_sync SHA → entry version joins:** single `isOriginal` asset (L231–235), `file_sync` query bound to partner/asset/version/status=2 (L236), `owned_storage` L153–160 enforces 7-col schema, binding, and resolution under `/opt/kaltura/web/content`, exactly 1 candidate, `stored SHA == SOURCE_PIN`; entry DB row partner-bound with numeric current version (L244–249). Version loop L252–255 over `sorted(set([-1,0,current]))` with `typed_equal` projection equality; list fixture requires `KalturaMediaListResponse`, 1 object, `totalCount` type-frozen to `'1'` (L256–258); source + logging config re-verified unchanged (L260–262). **Version 0 explicitly allowed** — no `>0` demand; `current==0` simply yields requests `{-1,0}`.
- **Wire types:** `media_projection` L29–35 projects exactly 5 keys, drops `dataUrl`, ID regex `[0-9]_[a-z0-9]{8}`, int/str numeric check with `type() in {int,str}` so `bool` is rejected; `typed_equal` L36–37 exact-type keywise equality (tests: bool-vs-int, int-vs-str).
- **Cleanup:** probe file `O_EXCL` 0644 → checksum-drift check → `unlink` + `not exists` in `finally` (L123–133); memfd closed, journal temp file, failure codes sanitized to `[A-Z0-9_]{1,100}` else `CONTROLLED_OPERATION_FAILED` (L265–268); `__main__` prints only generic rejection. Credential dir is nonce-scoped/mode-locked guest-private; acceptable residue on failure.
- **Safe public receipts:** driver report hardcodes `baseline_acceptance:False`, `benchmark_executed:False`; runner L66–76 requires each receipt to carry the nonce with both flags `False`, recursively forbids `secret/password/ks/dataUrl/response/raw_body` at every depth, and retains only exit/stdout/stderr SHAs + manifests.

## Verdict: bounded ALLOW_MINIMAL_UNTIMED

No concrete code BLOCKER found in the reviewed sources; all reviewed paths fail closed with sanitized receipts. This is **not** baseline/timing acceptance (`baseline_acceptance:False` everywhere; `guards.validate` reports `native_execution_proven_by_this_validator:False`).

Concrete native preconditions that must hold **at guest execution** (untested locally — functional assumptions, not code defects): guest hostname/IP identity, PHP 7.4 web SAPI (`apache2handler`/`fpm-fcgi`), `/opt/kaltura/*` and `/root/kaltura-baseline-private/*` presence/permissions, `mysql` socket + 48-hex password file, `kaltura-sanity.rc` synthetic partner, `systemctl`/`journalctl`/`ip` availability, sudo rights for staging + `systemd-run`, SSH `baseline74` via `/tmp/kaltura-php74-ssh.conf`, existing matching `inventory-r2.json`, and the frozen `short360.mp4` bytes at the runner-relative artifact path (not read here per denial).
